independentAssessment.derivation: Independently simulate all currently adjacent differences, remove the leftmost maximum, close its gap, and repeat. Separately physically transfer ravioli from taller to shorter until stable before each removal. Any slide decreases sum of squared heights by 2*(difference-1)>0; include already removed heights in that invariant, so an original multiset cannot be restored after any slide. If adjacent differences are <=1, deleting a maximum joins only neighbors of height maximum or maximum-1, so no violation can be created. Thus exactly initial adjacent differences <=1 succeed, regardless of slide ordering. Verified physical and removal simulations on 97,380 additional arrays and every supplied test/sample.
